## What is still open
- Maya will approve #247 once CI is green, but first wants the Orbitly drop count since #240 for Thursday's call with Orbitly — you have it: ≈1.18M events, ≈8.1% of their iOS volume [2][1].
- The replay that recovers those events for Orbitly (and Zest's pilot) must run from landing for 13/11 onward, only after #247 is deployed; you asked to be reminded [1].
- The note telling the iOS team to restore UUID `event_id`s in 3.2.1 still needs sending [1].
- From the incident-review prep: you owe an alert when the ingest dead-letter queue exceeds 1,000 messages, before Friday's review (20/11) [7].

## What changed
- Noa finalised #233 and will present the 12/11 postmortem at Friday's incident review [3].
- Zest Grocers confirmed their dashboards are complete again after the backfill; their Zendesk ticket is closed [6].
- #245, the CI Go bump to 1.23.4, was merged [4].

## What you did
- Traced Orbitly's ~8% iOS funnel drop to #240's `event_id`-only dedupe: kestrel-ios 3.2.0 sends `event_id` as a per-session counter, so events from different devices collided; Zest's pilot app was hit the same way [1].
- Rewrote the dedupe key to `project_id:device_id:event_id` with tests that still catch genuine replays, and opened PR #247 [1][2].
- Drafted the iOS team note and the post-deploy replay plan for Orbitly and Zest [1].
